results.content:
Changing or Cancelling an Order — Change shipping address
You can change the shipping address free of charge while the order status is "processing" (before it ships). Once an order has shipped, the address cannot be changed — the carrier may offer a redirect from the tracking page.

results.title: Shipping Policy
results.content:
Shipping Policy — Tracking
You receive a tracking link by email when your order ships. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to show the first scan.

results.title: Shipping Policy
results.content:
Shipping Policy — Delayed shipments
If tracking has not updated for 5 business days, or your order is more than 5 business days past the estimated delivery date, contact us. We open a trace with the carrier and, if the parcel is confirmed lost, we send a free replacement or a full refund — your choice.

results.title: Shipping Policy
results.content:
Shipping Policy — Processing time
Orders are packed and handed to the carrier within 1–2 business days. Orders placed after 2 pm Pacific on Friday ship the following Monday.

results.title: Returns Policy
results.content:
Returns Policy — How to start a return
Reply to your order confirmation email or contact support with your order number. We email a prepaid return label (US) within one business day. Refunds are issued within 2 business days of the return arriving at our warehouse.

results.title: Returns Policy
results.content:
Returns Policy — Bedding and textiles
Duvets, sheets and pillows can be returned within 30 days only if the original packaging is unopened, for hygiene reasons.

results.title: Returns Policy
results.content:
Returns Policy — Standard returns
You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Items must be unused, unwashed and in original packaging. Return shipping is free for customers in the US using our prepaid label; customers in Canada and Mexico pay return shipping.
